_comment: Orkeon Code settings template. Copy it to config/appsettings.local.json (ignored by git) and adjust the Llm section. The API key never goes in this file: ApiKeyEnvVar names the environment variable that holds it, and ORKEON_Llm__ApiKey, when set, wins over everything. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works through BaseUrl; see docs/configuration.md for the providers Orkeon supports, and for the MCP:Servers and Plugins sections whose tools the tools.extra session key offers to the assistant. Every key below is explained in docs/configuration.md: Orkeon refuses a key it does not know inside its sections, so this file carries no other comment.
